answer: By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A canyon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the timber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit.
